groups.summary: Losing electric service due to inclement or extreme weather conditions can be catastrophic.
groups.intro: Losing electric service due to inclement or extreme weather conditions can be catastrophic. Texas Elite can tailor a package for your needs and install a power generator system that is designed to automatically engage when your local power company is unable to continue service.

about.title: About Texas Elite Electrical Services
text: Texas Elite is committed to deliver specialized electrical infrastructure services and solutions that support the operations of industry, becoming the provider of choice by exceeding the expectations of our customers.

TEES is a family owned and operated company that takes pride in the quality of our work and establishing a personal bond with our clients. We have been successfully serving the Texas Gulf Coast Region continuously since 2001 and have developed strategic partnerships and personal relationships along the way.

TEES has created a working environment built upon a tradition of excellence by providing the best equipment, advanced technical skills and cultivating superior customer relations. We believe strongly in getting the job done right the first time and delivering an exceptional product to our clients.
